source.text: Fortress of Amerikkka is a 1989 action film directed by Eric Louzil and distributed by Troma Entertainment. The movie follows John Whitecloud, a criminal rebel who's out for revenge against a corrupt Sheriff and a militia run by a crazed General. It is often cited by Troma fans as one of the company's worst films. The director, Eric Louzil, later went on to direct both sequels to Troma's "Class of Nuke 'Em High".
source.title: Fortress of Amerikkka
